evidence_projection_relationship: evidence projection may support annotation creation, but annotation judgment is not mechanically derived from projection

required_evidence: Evidence of a movement mechanism that can traverse arbitrary surfaces rather than only a fixed ladder path.
Evidence that wall and ceiling surfaces and their usable surface normals can be obtained.
Evidence that movement and turning can be maintained in a surface-relative coordinate frame.
Evidence that the capability can integrate with the existing AI so normal movement, turning, actions, and attacks remain AI-controlled.
Evidence of a JSON area-configuration entry point and a runtime binding from configured areas to the current area.
A fail-closed rule that forbids crawling in unconfigured, unknown, or parse-failed areas.
A reliable way to identify enemies that already support a prone locomotion pose for ceiling traversal.
Positive integration evidence that the selected mechanism does not inherently replace or disable normal attack state transitions.
forbidden_evidence: A fixed ladder route, fixed path, or straight-line movement mechanism treated as proof of arbitrary wall and ceiling traversal.
The user-provided reference clue bep/plugins/xxxrundowns/.json treated as a verified path, schema, or field definition.
A reference Mod, community description, symbol name, nop/ret wrapper, or abstract declaration promoted to current behavioral authority.
A current product readiness, can_generate_patch, blocker code, or prior Agent/RAG output used to create or decide the expected judgment.
A permissive fallback that enables crawling when area configuration is absent, unknown, or cannot be parsed.
A mechanism that wholly takes over or pauses the original AI treated as satisfying normal AI movement, actions, and attacks.
Absence of evidence that attacks are disabled treated as positive proof that normal attack state transitions remain available.

forbidden_hook_full_identities.forbidden_scope: not acceptable as sufficient planning Hook while its exact body is nop/ret

not acceptable as sufficient planning Hook while the exact declaration is abstract and has no body

required_missing_evidence: A mechanism for arbitrary-surface movement rather than only a fixed ladder route.
A way to obtain wall and ceiling surfaces and their surface normals.
Movement and turning maintained in a surface-relative coordinate frame.
Integration with the existing AI rather than wholly taking over or pausing it.
A JSON area-configuration entry point and runtime area binding.
Default prohibition when area configuration is absent, unknown, or cannot be parsed.
A reliable way to identify enemies that support a prone locomotion pose.
Positive integration evidence that the mechanism does not inherently replace or disable normal attack state transitions.
